Definition: Betsalel, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Bezaleel = "in the shadow (i.e. protection) of God"; 1) son of Uri and grandson of Hur; a skilled Judahite artisan in all works of metal, wood, and stone and one of the architects of the tabernacle; 2) an Israelite, one of the sons of Pahath-moab, in the time of Ezra who had taken a strange wife
